_note: Demo playbook for a FICTIONAL health insurer ('Oria Santé'). Policies, owners and thresholds are invented for this portfolio project and are not any real company's rules.

categories.label: NDA request
categories.description: Someone needs a non-disclosure agreement with a prospect, partner or supplier.
categories.auto_answer:
You can use the standard mutual NDA without involving Legal, as long as the other party accepts it unchanged.
1. Download it from Legal Hub > Templates > Mutual NDA (latest version).
2. Fill in the parties and the purpose of the discussions.
3. Send it for e-signature with the usual signature tool and file the signed copy in the contracts folder.
If the other party sends its own NDA, or asks to change any clause, submit a new request and Commercial Legal will review it.

categories.label: Contract review
categories.description: Review, negotiation or redlines of a customer, supplier or partner contract, or a change to a counterparty's terms.

categories.label: Dispute or formal notice
categories.description: A dispute, formal notice (mise en demeure), threatened or actual legal action, or a lawyer writing on behalf of a counterparty.

categories.label: Signature authority
categories.description: Who is allowed to sign a document, signature thresholds, delegation, whether Legal must be involved before signing.
categories.auto_answer:
Signature rules (demo policy):
- Up to EUR 50k per year on our standard terms: your team lead signs.
- EUR 50k to 250k per year, or any change to our standard terms: department head signs after a Legal review.
- Above EUR 250k per year: CFO or CEO.
Client contracts on unchanged standard terms do not need a Legal review. Everything is signed through the e-signature tool. If a signatory is away, the delegate listed on the Legal Hub can sign.

categories.label: Template or policy lookup
categories.description: Looking for an existing template, model letter, policy or internal guideline.
categories.auto_answer: All current templates and internal policies are on the Legal Hub (Notion > Corporate > Legal Hub), with the version date on each page. Use the search bar with the document name. If the template you need doesn't exist, submit a new request naming it and Legal Ops will add it.

categories.label: Data subject request
categories.description: A member, employee or other person asks to access, delete, correct or port their personal data, or objects to its use.
categories.note: GDPR Art. 12(3): answer within one month of receipt (extendable by two months for complex requests). Do not reply to the person before Privacy confirms their identity.

categories.label: Personal data incident
categories.description: Personal data may have been lost, exposed, sent to the wrong person, accessed without authorisation, or a supplier reports a security incident.
categories.note: GDPR Art. 33: a personal data breach must be notified to the supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, unless it is unlikely to result in a risk. The clock may already be running.

categories.label: New use of personal data
categories.description: A new feature, project, data flow or data sharing that uses personal data, especially health data, or a question from a data protection authority about a processing.

categories.label: New supplier or tool
categories.description: Onboarding a new SaaS tool, supplier or subcontractor that will access company or personal data.

categories.label: AI use and AI Act
categories.description: Using AI tools at work, building AI features, automated decisions, or EU AI Act questions.
categories.auto_answer:
AI tools policy (demo):
- Approved AI tools can be used for work content that contains no personal data and nothing confidential.
- Never paste member data, health information, employee data or confidential contracts into a tool that is not on the approved list.
- Any AI use on personal data, any member-facing AI feature and any AI that helps decide about people (pricing, claims, hiring) needs a review by Privacy & AI governance first: submit a new request describing the use case.

categories.label: Marketing review
categories.description: Review of ads, landing pages, social posts, contests, testimonials or sales material before publication.

categories.label: Insurance compliance
categories.description: Insurance regulation: duty of advice, product changes, policy documents, distribution rules, guarantees.

categories.label: Member complaint
categories.description: How to handle a member complaint or a contested refusal of reimbursement.
categories.note: Complaint handling deadlines apply (in France, ACPR recommendation 2022-R-01: acknowledge within 10 business days, answer within 2 months).

categories.label: Employment law
categories.description: Employment questions: contracts, trial periods, remote work abroad, dismissals, working time.

categories.label: Other / unclear
categories.description: Not a legal, privacy, compliance or governance question, or too vague to classify.
